details: US annual inflation for July 2026 held at 3.4%, with core inflation cooling to 2.5%, precisely matching Wall Street forecasts. This moderate inflation reading has led to an almost even split in expectations for the Federal Reserve's September rate decision, with rate futures now pricing roughly a 50% chance of a hold versus a quarter-point hike. Bitcoin experienced short-term volatility following the data release, dipping slightly before a rebound, as a less aggressive Fed stance could ease pressure on risk assets.
title: US July Inflation Matches Forecasts, Fed Rate Hike Odds Split

details: A recent Reuters poll, conducted in August 2026, reveals that a significant majority of economists (83%) expect the European Central Bank (ECB) to raise its deposit facility rate by 25 basis points to 2.50% at its upcoming September meeting. This growing consensus reflects continued efforts by the ECB to combat inflation, indicating a hawkish monetary policy stance. Higher interest rates in the Eurozone could impact global liquidity and investor sentiment, potentially leading to a flight from riskier assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Economists Predict Another ECB Rate Hike in September

details: Ongoing geopolitical uncertainty, particularly the deadlock between the United States and Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz and reports of attacks on vessels in the region, continues to fuel concerns over potential oil supply disruptions. This sustained tension is keeping oil prices elevated and contributing to persistent inflation worries globally. Such instability typically increases market volatility and fosters a risk-off sentiment among investors, which can negatively impact risk-sensitive assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Keep Oil Prices, Inflation Concerns Elevated
